referenceSources.description:
A lightweight Caterham Seven Academy race car, finished in grey with neon green roll cage and accents, powers through a corner on a paved circuit. The open‑wheel design reveals its suspension and side‑exit exhaust, while Avon tires grip the asphalt. The front grille bears a bold "7" and "QUALCAST" branding, and the number "42" is displayed on the hood.

This model is part of the Caterham Academy series, an entry‑level UK championship for novice drivers. The 2026 cars are equipped with a 1.3‑liter turbocharged HR13 engine built in Valladolid by Horse, delivering 130 CV to the rear wheels through a six‑speed gearbox. Road‑legal yet track‑ready, each car includes safety features like a roll cage, racing seats with six‑point harnesses, and low‑grip tires to teach car control.
